column11: already approved: the Alecensa label covers adjuvant treatment of resected ALK-positive NSCLC and ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC, selected on tumour tissue or plasma (openFDA set 42c49deb-713b-427a-9670-08af08adcffb, effective 2026-08-21, sections 1 and 2.1). B-FAST cohort A gives alectinib 600 mg twice daily to ALK-positive advanced NSCLC detected in blood (NCT03178552, clinicaltrials.gov API v2), the labelled population. Cohort B, alectinib 900 mg twice daily in RET fusion-positive NSCLC, is the only part outside the label and it is finished: 'Enrolment closed prematurely with Phase II uninitiated', best responses of stable disease in 4 of 5 evaluable patients, and 'further investigation was not conducted due to the development of selective RET inhibitors pralsetinib and selpercatinib' (Dziadziuszko R et al., Contemp Oncol (Pozn) 2023;27(4):217-223, doi 10.5114/wo.2023.135246)
